concerns.text: Task T004 implements a covariate‑adjusted Spearman correlation (regressing out age, sex, levodopa dose before computing the rank correlation). This deviates from FR‑004, which explicitly requires a plain Spearman rank correlation of per‑patient taxon‑slope vs. clinical‑slope without covariate adjustment. The task therefore does not satisfy the functional requirement as specified, constituting a requirement‑level constraint violation.
